raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

The HiSparse coordinator updated residency one page and one resident group at a time, with a block-pool call per block. When a request's whole context is GPU-resident (~1.3k pages × 20 groups), one `schedule()` spends tens of ms in Python and stalls every running request. Direct GPU landing for P/D (#55398) makes that the common case, so this should merge first.

This PR batches each operation (adopt, unpin, writeback planning and completion, copy recording, free) into one pass per request and one block-pool call. `HiSparseResidentManager` gains `get_residency_pages`, `adopt_resident_pages` and `drop_resident_pages`, which touch only the requested pages, so per-step cost does not grow with context length. Behavior is unchanged, including the order blocks return to the free queue; two new tests pin that order.

Not a duplicate: no open PR touches these loops.

## Test Plan

- `pytest tests/v1/core/test_prefix_caching.py tests/v1/core/test_deferred_block_free.py tests/v1/core/test_scheduler.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_hisparse_connector.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_hisparse_stats.py tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py`
- GSM8K (`tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py`, 5-shot, concurrency 128) with `--kv-cache-memory-bytes 2G` to force host offload.
- 8×B200, GLM-5.3-NVFP4, TP4, multi-turn agentic dataset (80K-token first turn, 13 turns), C=8, N=16, 220 output tokens, fresh servers per point, two dataset offsets per arm. P/D: 1P + 1D, TP4 each, NIXL over RDMA.

## Test Result

- Unit tests: no new failures; the failures here match `main` on the same host.
- GSM8K: 0.911 on both arms, with ~118 GB host-to-device on both.

| Setup | Arm | TTFT p50 (ms) | Output tok/s | `schedule()` (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-P/D | main | 604 / 633 | 246 / 243 | p99 50 |
| | this PR | 528 / 534 | 259 / 258 | p99 27 |
| P/D, host landing | main | 500 / 509 | 250 / 253 | p50 after recv 3.0 |
| | this PR | 507 / 502 | 255 / 252 | p50 after recv 3.0 |
| P/D, direct landing | main | 491 | 254.6 | p50 after recv 3.0 |
| | #55398 | 758 | 246.8 | p50 after recv 48.8 |
| | #55398 + this PR | 553 | 256.0 | p50 after recv 21.3 |

---

+def test_hisparse_clean_pages_unpin_in_write_completion_order():
+    """The pool reuses unpinned pages in the order their host writes completed."""
+    manager = make_hisparse_kv_cache_manager(
+        64, 32, enable_caching=True, num_resident_groups=2
+    )
+    coordinator = get_hisparse_coordinator(manager)
+    coordinator.max_spill_pages = 1
+    num_tokens = 4 * HISPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE
+    requests = [
+        make_request(name, list(range(i, i + num_tokens)), HISPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE, sha256)
+        for i, name in enumerate(("a", "b"))
+    ]
+    spills = []
+    for request in requests:
+        for hot in coordinator.hot_managers:
+            hot.require_hot(request.request_id)
+            hot.allocate_new_blocks(request.request_id, num_tokens, num_tokens)
+        assert _allocate_scheduled(manager, request, num_tokens) is not None
+        spills += coordinator.build_offload_command().page_transfers
+    for request in requests:
+        coordinator.plan_prefix_materialization(request.request_id, num_tokens)
+        spills += coordinator.build_offload_command().page_transfers
+    pages = [coordinator.pending_spills[spill.transfer_id].page for spill in spills]
+    assert pages == [("a", 0), ("b", 0), ("a", 1), ("b", 1)]
+
+    counts = {spill.transfer_id: 1 for spill in spills}
+    coordinator.update_spills(counts, counts)
+
+    expected = [
+        resident.req_to_blocks[request_id][page_idx].block_id
+        for request_id, page_idx in pages
+        for resident in coordinator.resident_managers
+    ]
+    free_ids = [
+        block.block_id
+        for block in manager.block_pool.free_block_queue.get_all_free_blocks()
+    ]
+    assert free_ids[-len(expected) :] == expected
+
+
+def test_hisparse_freed_request_spills_are_reused_newest_first():
+    """Acked spills of a freed request free their blocks as if one at a time."""
+    manager = make_hisparse_kv_cache_manager(
+        64, 32, enable_caching=True, num_resident_groups=2
+    )
+    coordinator = get_hisparse_coordinator(manager)
+    num_tokens = 4 * HISPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE
+    request = make_request("a", list(range(num_tokens)), HISPARSE_BLOCK_SIZE, sha256)
+    assert _allocate_scheduled(manager, request, num_tokens) is not None
+    spills = coordinator.build_offload_command().page_transfers
+    assert len(spills) == 4
+    manager.free(request)
+
+    counts = {spill.transfer_id: 1 for spill in spills}
+    coordinator.update_spills(counts, counts)
+
+    spilled = [block_id for spill in spills for block_id in spill.resident_block_ids]
+    free_ids = [
+        block.block_id
+        for block in manager.block_pool.free_block_queue.get_all_free_blocks()
+    ]
+    assert free_ids[: len(spilled)] == spilled[::-1]
+
+

     """Clean pages of a finished request are free-queue blocks, not pins."""
